juiceResources.description:
juice `juiceResources` options used to inline the CSS of the html part

Deep merged over the email-templates defaults:
`{ applyStyleTags: false, removeStyleTags: false, webResources: { images: false, relativeTo } }`,
`webResources.relativeTo` being the templates folder

Schema.description:
Parameters for the Mailer service configuration

Configures the email transport and where templates are rendered from

SES.description:
SES AWS Bean if transport === "ses"

Credentials inside can be encrypted with `webda config encrypt`

args.description: Extra arguments for the sendmail command

auth.description: Authentication data for the transport (`auth.pass` can be encrypted with `webda config encrypt`)

buffer.description: Return a Buffer instead of a stream for streamTransport

connectionTimeout.description: Milliseconds to wait for the connection to establish

dnsTimeout.description: Milliseconds to wait for DNS resolution

greetingTimeout.description: Milliseconds to wait for the greeting after connection is established

host.description: SMTP server hostname or IP address

ignoreTLS.description: Turns off STARTTLS support if true

jsonTransport.description: Return a JSON string representation of the message

localAddress.description: Local interface to bind to for network connections

maxConnections.description: Count of maximum simultaneous connections to make against the SMTP server

maxMessages.description: Limits the message count to be sent using a single connection

name.description: Optional hostname of the client, used for identifying to the server

newline.description: Line ending style ("unix" or "windows") for sendmail or stream transport

opportunisticTLS.description: Attempts to upgrade the connection to TLS when advertised by the server

pool.description: Use pooled connections instead of creating a new connection for every email

port.description: SMTP port to connect to (defaults to 587 if secure is false or 465 if true)

rateDelta.description: Defines the time measuring period in milliseconds for rate limiting

rateLimit.description: Limits the message count to be sent in rateDelta time

requireTLS.description: Forces the client to use STARTTLS if true

secure.description: If true the connection uses TLS when connecting to server; if false then TLS is used if server supports the STARTTLS extension

socketTimeout.description: Milliseconds of inactivity to allow before timing out the socket

streamTransport.description: Return a stream instead of sending the message

templateService.description: Name of the TemplateService to render with when neither `templates` nor `templatesEngine` are set

templates.description:
Folder containing the mailer templates

When set (or when `templatesEngine` is set), the mailer renders with its own renderer on this folder,
even if a TemplateService is configured. Left unset, the `templateService` is used if it exists,
otherwise `./templates`

templatesEngine.description:
Template engine to use with the mailer own renderer, `mustache` when unset

Setting it makes the mailer use its own renderer, like `templates`

tls.description: Additional node.js TLSSocket options to be passed to the socket constructor

transport.description: Define the type of transport to use

Schema.title: Mailer

hash.description:
Will be computed by the service

hash of the content

metadata.description: Metadatas stored along with the binary
